pages.title: Seasonal Crops
pages.text: Serene Seasons lists vanilla crops by season: wheat in summer and autumn, carrots in spring and autumn, and so on. Mushrooms, nether wart and oak saplings grow year round.

pages.title: Farmer's Delight
pages.text:
Farmer's Delight adds its own season data:
- Tomato: summer
- Cabbage: autumn, winter
- Onion: spring, autumn
- Rice: summer, autumn

See [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

pages.title: Tomato Seeds
pages.text: Summer crop. Out of season they stop. A glass roof keeps a patch growing.

pages.title: Cabbage Seeds
pages.text: Autumn and winter crop. One of the few things you can grow in the cold.

pages.title: Fruit trees
pages.text: Fruits Delight trees follow seasons too: pear, peach and blueberry in spring; lychee, mango, durian, lemon and pineapple in summer; apple, orange, fig and cranberry in autumn; persimmon, kiwi and hawberry in winter.

pages.title: Other mods
pages.text: Seasonal Integration adds Berry Good's sweet berries (spring, winter) and glow berries, and My Nether's Delight peppers, to year round. Fungus Delight mushrooms grow in any season.
